minecraft:particle_initialization.per_render_expression: variable.t = variable.particle_age * 20; variable.l = variable.particle_lifetime * 20; variable.ang = variable.base + variable.spd * variable.t - variable.spd / 2 * variable.t * variable.t / variable.l + ((variable.spd < 0 && variable.ax == 1) ? 180 : 0); variable.rad = variable.r2 + (variable.r1 - variable.r2) * math.pow(0.9, variable.t); variable.fade = math.clamp((variable.t - variable.l / 2) / variable.l, 0, 1); variable.mix = variable.t > variable.l / 2 ? 1 - math.pow(0.8, variable.t - variable.l / 2) : 0;
minecraft:particle_initialization.per_update_expression: variable.t = variable.particle_age * 20; variable.l = variable.particle_lifetime * 20; variable.ang = variable.base + variable.spd * variable.t - variable.spd / 2 * variable.t * variable.t / variable.l + ((variable.spd < 0 && variable.ax == 1) ? 180 : 0); variable.rad = variable.r2 + (variable.r1 - variable.r2) * math.pow(0.9, variable.t); variable.fade = math.clamp((variable.t - variable.l / 2) / variable.l, 0, 1); variable.mix = variable.t > variable.l / 2 ? 1 - math.pow(0.8, variable.t - variable.l / 2) : 0;
